hypotheses.title: 附子's processing is a hydrolysis ladder, and the classical steps specify where to stop

chain.preparation: 炮 (roast until split) → 去皮臍 → 蜜水煮 / 甘草水浸  (per 雷公炮炙論)
chain.chemotype: diester diterpene alkaloids: aconitine → benzoylaconine → aconine (successive ester hydrolysis)
chain.target: voltage-gated Na⁺ channel, site 2 — aconitine holds the channel open; aconine barely binds
chain.indication: Aconite cardiotoxicity and neurotoxicity; the processed drug is the therapeutic one

provenance.title: 雷公炮炙論
provenance.author: 雷斆 Lei Xiao
provenance.span: 凡使附子，先於文武火上炮令裂，去皮臍，乘熱切之；又以蜜水煮，令毒去而力存。炮之得法，則毒輕而效速。

provenance.title: 神農本草經
provenance.author: 神農 (attrib.)
provenance.span: 附子，味辛溫。主風寒咳逆邪氣，溫中，金瘡，破癥堅積聚，血瘕，寒濕踒躄，拘攣膝痛，不能行步。

provenance.title: 傷寒論
provenance.author: 張仲景 Zhang Zhongjing
provenance.span: 四逆湯方：甘草二兩炙，乾薑一兩半，附子一枚生用去皮破八片。

hypotheses.falsification_plan: Quantify the three alkaloids by LC-MS across processing time and temperature for raw, 炮, and 炮+蜜煮 material. The mechanistic claim is refuted if the diester:monester ratio does not fall monotonically along the classical step sequence, or if the endpoint the text names does not coincide with where cardiotoxicity (zebrafish or rat heart-rate assay) stops falling. Positive control: pure aconitine hydrolysed under identical conditions. One targeted LC-MS method runs the whole thing.
hypotheses.uncertainty: The text names its endpoint by appearance ('炮令裂'), not by temperature, so 'where to stop' is our inference. And 傷寒論 uses 生用 附子 in 四逆湯 — which complicates the tidy claim that processing is always necessary. That exception is itself a finding and is reported rather than smoothed away.

flags: aconitine is a highly toxic cardiotoxin; raw 附子 is not a food and not a self-treatment
this is analytical toxicology, never a preparation method for use
the therapeutic window is narrow and clinician-supervised in every legitimate context

dossier.rationale: The cleanest 'what was hidden between the lines' in the whole corpus. 雷公炮炙論 does not say 'processing reduces toxicity'. It says: roast until it splits, peel, cut while hot, then boil in honey water, and then the poison is light and the effect is fast. That is a hydrolysis protocol with an endpoint, performed for fifteen centuries before it was described.
mechanistic_chain: Aconitine is a diester — an acetate at C8 and a benzoate at C14 on a norditerpene scaffold.
Heating in aqueous media hydrolyses the C8 acetate first → benzoylaconine (roughly 100× less toxic).
Further hydrolysis removes the C14 benzoate → aconine, effectively inactive at Na⁺ channels.
The classical endpoint ('split, peel, honey-water boil') sits at the monester stage — activity retained, cardiotoxicity largely gone.
The 傷寒論 '生用' exception for 四逆湯 is a deliberate high-potency choice inside a controlled decoction — exactly the distinction modern granule products lose.
prior_art_refs: 雷斆 Lei Xiao — 雷公炮炙論 (5th–6th c.)
Singhuber et al. (2009) — Aconitum in traditional Chinese medicine: a review
diester diterpene alkaloid hydrolysis kinetics literature
dossier.cost_estimate: Low — one LC-MS/MS method, three processing arms, no synthesis.
next_steps: Model 炮制 as a Process entity with (temperature, medium, duration, target-metabolite).
Flag every modern dosage form that omits a classical processing step the corpus calls necessary.
Report the 生用 exception — it is the test of whether we read the text or paraphrase it.

hypotheses.title: The name 木通 covers a harmless vine and a carcinogenic one — and the corpus already says which is which
hypotheses.discovery_class_label: 异名同物 · name collision & adulteration

chain.plant: Akebia quinata / A. trifoliata  (vs. Aristolochia manshuriensis 關木通)
chain.preparation: Decoction of the stem — 木通 as dispensed c.1600–2000
chain.chemotype: akeboside triterpenoid saponins  VS  aristolochic acid I/II (nitro-phenanthrene carboxylic acids)
chain.target: proximal-tubule organic anion transporters OAT1/OAT3 (AA uptake); covalent DNA adducts at adenine N6
chain.indication: Aristolochic acid nephropathy → interstitial fibrosis, upper-tract urothelial carcinoma

provenance.title: 本草綱目
provenance.author: 李時珍 Li Shizhen
provenance.span: 木通：古方所用木通，即今之通草；後世以有細孔者可通氣，故謂之木通。今有一種關木通，色黃味苦，與木通形似而性不同，不可不辨。

provenance.title: Plants of the World Online / WCVP
provenance.author: Royal Botanic Gardens Kew
provenance.span: Akebia quinata — Lardizabalaceae. Aristolochia manshuriensis — Aristolochiaceae.

provenance.title: Dr Duke's Phytochemical & Ethnobotanical Databases
provenance.title_en: Dr Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases
provenance.author: James A. Duke (USDA ARS)
provenance.span: Aristolochia manshuriensis: aristolochic acid I and II; nephrotoxicity and carcinogenicity records.

provenance.title: The Complete Herbal
provenance.author: Nicholas Culpeper
provenance.span: Comparative control only: the Western corpus is ≤3% of tokens, used to test whether this signal is an artefact of any large botanical corpus. Contributes no evidence here.

hypotheses.falsification_plan: The claim is a toxicity divergence, so it dies if the divergence is small. Compute compound-set distance between every taxon historically named 木通/通草 in the corpus; if the Aristolochia taxa are not the outliers on aristolochic-acid presence, the ranking is wrong. Second kill: if the corpus never presents 關木通 as a 木通 variant before 1900, the risk is modern substitution, not an inherited encoding — a different, equally publishable finding. Cheapest confirmation: LC-MS/MS for AA-I on retail 木通 decoction pieces, n=30, with the AA-DNA adduct (7-(deoxyadenosin-N6-yl)aristolactam I) as exposure biomarker.
hypotheses.uncertainty: We cannot know what was in the bottle in 1600. The name collision is documented; the dispensing substitution is inferred from later commentary. Rank order inside the colliding set is sensitive to how we weight toxicity against therapeutic divergence — EVALUATION.md reports that sensitivity.

flags: aristolochic acid is an IARC Group 1 carcinogen and a documented cause of nephropathy
no preparation, dose or substitution recipe appears anywhere in this output
regulatory ground truth: 2003 PRC ban on 關木通; 2001 FDA warning

dossier.rationale: The strongest thing this corpus can do for public health is not discover a new drug. It is to notice that one name has been standing for two different plants. 《本草綱目》 writes the warning already, as a marginal note about colour and taste — four centuries before the Belgian slimming-clinic outbreak and the Taiwanese nephropathy cohort made it undeniable. The encoded layer was there. Nobody had a machine that read marginal notes as data.
mechanistic_chain: 木通 in pre-modern formularies denotes Akebia species — triterpenoid saponins, no nitroaromatics.
From roughly the late Qing, 關木通 (Aristolochia manshuriensis) is dispensed under the same name as a cheaper, more bitter stem.
Aristolochic acid I is taken up by proximal-tubule OAT1/OAT3 and bioactivated by nitroreduction.
The aristolactam forms covalent DNA adducts at adenine N6 — mutagenic and stable for decades.
Chronic interstitial nephritis and upper-tract urothelial carcinoma follow years later, which is why the signal was missed for so long.
prior_art_refs: Vanherweghem et al. (1993) — rapidly progressive interstitial renal fibrosis in a slimming regimen
IARC Monographs Vol. 100A (2012) — aristolochic acid, Group 1
Nortier et al. (2000) — urothelial carcinoma associated with aristolochic acid
dossier.cost_estimate: Low for the corpus arm (already in the KG); medium for the LC-MS confirmation.
next_steps: Promote 异名同物 to a first-class edge type: drug_name → {(taxon, era, confidence)}.
Rank colliding sets by maximum toxicity divergence, not by frequency.
Publish the ranking as a public list — this is a deliverable a regulator can use.

chain.chemotype: notoginsenosides R1/Rg1/Rb1 (dammarane saponins)  VS  pyrrolizidine alkaloids (senecionine type)

provenance.span: 三七：味甘微苦，性溫，無毒。止血散血定痛，金刃箭傷跌撲杖瘡血出不止者，嚼爛罨之即止。

provenance.title: 本草綱目
provenance.author: 李時珍 Li Shizhen
provenance.span: 菊三七：葉似菊，根如三七而大，南人亦呼為三七，以之治血。其力大而性猛，久服令人腹痛。按此非真三七也。

provenance.title: Plants of the World Online / WCVP
provenance.author: Royal Botanic Gardens Kew
provenance.span: Panax notoginseng — Araliaceae. Gynura pseudochina — Asteraceae; pyrrolizidine alkaloid occurrence recorded.

hypotheses.falsification_plan: Case series of herbal-product users with a hepatic adverse event: if no PAs are detectable in the implicated product and no Gynura DNA barcode is found, the substitution route is unsupported for that series. For the corpus claim alone: if 菊三七 is never presented as a 三七 substitute in any pre-1900 text, the collision is industrial-age rather than inherited.
hypotheses.uncertainty: The 菊三七 note in 《本草綱目》 is a caution about potency, not a modern toxicity warning. Reading our knowledge of PA hepatotoxicity back into it would be anachronism. The honest formulation is 'the name was already known to be loose', not 'the ancients knew about pyrrolizidine alkaloids'.

flags: pyrrolizidine alkaloids cause dose-dependent, sometimes irreversible hepatic injury
adulteration in the supplement supply chain is the modern risk vector
no dosage or product guidance is given

dossier.rationale: Same structural failure, second instance: two roots, one name, one use. It is worse than 木通 in a specific way — 菊三七 was already flagged in the classical text as 'not the real 三七, its force is violent, long use causes abdominal pain'. The corpus contains the safety note. The job is to turn a sixteenth-century aside into a ranked adulteration risk.
mechanistic_chain: Both roots are bitter-astringent and used for bleeding and stasis, so substitution is clinically invisible.
Panax notoginseng acts via ginsenoside saponins; no PA exposure.
Gynura carries senecionine-type pyrrolizidine alkaloids.
CYP3A4 oxidises PAs to dehydropyrrolizine esters, which alkylate hepatocyte DNA and protein.
Sinusoidal endothelial injury → veno-occlusive disease, often presenting late.
prior_art_refs: Zuckerman et al. (2016) — pyrrolizidine alkaloids and hepatic sinusoidal obstruction syndrome
WHO/IPCS pyrrolizidine alkaloid risk assessment
dossier.cost_estimate: Low — barcoding plus targeted PA analysis on a retail panel.
next_steps: Add DNA-barcode evidence as an edge attribute on every 异名同物 pair.
Rank colliding pairs that differ in severity class — that is the actionable list.

hypotheses.title: 九蒸九曬 is a detoxification protocol: 生首烏 and 制首烏 are different drugs

chain.preparation: 生用 (raw) vs 制 — nine steam-and-sun cycles with black bean decoction
chain.chemotype: raw: stilbene glycosides (TSG) + emodin anthraquinones; processed: hydrolysed aglycones, altered anthraquinone profile
chain.target: hepatocyte — mitochondrial injury and CYP/UGT-mediated bioactivation (candidate); TSG is the suspect fraction
chain.indication: Herb-induced liver injury from unprocessed 生首烏 in 'hair-blackening' supplements

provenance.title: 本草綱目
provenance.author: 李時珍 Li Shizhen
provenance.span: 何首烏：味苦澀微溫。生者有毒，制者無毒。九蒸九曬，黑豆同蒸，則補益之功成而毒去。生用則令人發熱、腹瀉。

provenance.title: 雷公炮炙論
provenance.author: 雷斆 Lei Xiao
provenance.span: 凡藥有毒者，皆先以炮製減其毒，此制方之要也。

hypotheses.falsification_plan: Compare 生 vs 制 extract cytotoxicity in HepG2 and primary human hepatocytes at matched dry mass, with TSG and emodin by HPLC. Refuted if the processed extract is not less cytotoxic, or if the TSG fraction is not the dose-limiting toxic component. The clinical pattern to reproduce: unprocessed product, weeks of exposure, cholestatic or mixed injury.
hypotheses.uncertainty: Commercial cycle counts vary from 4 to 9 and are rarely declared; the dose-response for cycle count is not in the corpus. Attribution to TSG is a candidate, not a conclusion.

flags: documented herb-induced liver injury; regulatory warnings in several jurisdictions
no product, dose or duration guidance is given
toxicology analysis, not a recommendation about any supplement

dossier.rationale: 《本草綱目》 says it plainly: raw is toxic, processed is not, and it names the process. The modern failure mode is that 'hair-blackening' products are made from cheap raw root and sold without the processing claim. The corpus holds both the warning and the protocol — exactly the pair you need to build a product-risk test.
mechanistic_chain: Raw root carries high TSG and emodin glycoside loads.
Nine steam cycles with black bean progressively hydrolyse glycosides and shift the anthraquinone profile.
The processed material is the one the text calls 無毒.
Unprocessed material retains the fraction implicated in hepatocyte injury.
Therefore the processing step is a safety control, not a preference.
prior_art_refs: Lin et al. — Polygonum multiflorum hepatotoxicity reviews
NMPA and MHRA safety communications on 何首烏
dossier.cost_estimate: Low — two extracts, one cell model, one HPLC method.
next_steps: Encode cycle-count as a numeric Process attribute so the KG can ask 'how many cycles?'.
Attach a processing-omitted risk flag to finished-product classes.

hypotheses.title: The 使 courier is a pharmacokineticist: formula role predicts CYP/P-gp modulation

chain.plant: Role-annotated formulas across the corpus — 胡椒/蓽茇 (Piper), 甘草 (Glycyrrhiza), 生薑 (Zingiber)
chain.preparation: Whole-formula decoction; the courier herb in the 使 position
chain.chemotype: piperine, glycyrrhizin, 6-gingerol — a chemically diverse set with one shared activity
chain.target: CYP3A4 inhibition and P-glycoprotein modulation — i.e. oral bioavailability of the 君 herb
chain.indication: Systematic enrichment test: do 使 herbs inhibit CYP3A4/P-gp more often than 君 herbs?

provenance.title: 太平惠民和劑局方
provenance.author: 陳師文 Chen Shiwen et al.
provenance.span: 君臣佐使者，制方之要也。君為主，臣為輔，佐為制，使為引。主病之謂君，佐君之謂臣，應臣之謂使。

provenance.title: 本草綱目
provenance.author: 李時珍 Li Shizhen
provenance.span: 胡椒：味辛大溫，無毒。主下氣溫中，去痰，除臟腑中風冷。近世食品多賴此以行藥力。

provenance.title: Dr Duke's Phytochemical & Ethnobotanical Databases
provenance.title_en: Dr Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases
provenance.author: James A. Duke (USDA ARS)
provenance.span: Piper longum: piperine — bioavailability enhancement, CYP3A4 inhibition and P-glycoprotein interaction records.

hypotheses.falsification_plan: Computed, not wet. Take every formula in `formulas.csv` with role annotations; take every ingredient with a ChEMBL CYP3A4 or P-gp record; compute enrichment of 'inhibitor' among 使-role herbs versus 君-role herbs, with a permutation null over role labels (10⁴ shuffles). Refuted if observed enrichment sits inside the null distribution. Then confirm one untested courier experimentally — piperine is already known, so pick a null one.
hypotheses.uncertainty: Role labels are edition-specific and sometimes contested. The confound is sharp: courier herbs are often aromatic and small-dose, and small aromatics are over-represented among CYP modulators for unrelated reasons. We cannot yet separate 'courier because it is a PK modulator' from 'both follow from being a volatile aromatic'.

flags: the practical consequence is herb–drug interaction risk — a warning, not a recommendation

dossier.rationale: 君臣佐使 is a four-way classification that every classical formulary carries and no modern database encodes. If 使 is not decoration but a functional prediction about absorption, then the canon contains a pharmacokinetic annotation layer — labelled, centuries old, and computable tomorrow. That is the strongest version of 'what was hidden'.
mechanistic_chain: 君 bears the primary therapeutic action.
使 is defined by direction and guidance — 應臣之謂使, the one that responds to the minister.
In the piperine case the 'guidance' is literal: intestinal CYP3A4 and P-gp inhibition raises the 君 herb's exposure.
If the role label is predictive, that relationship should hold beyond the famous examples.
Test: role enrichment against bioactivity databases, against a permutation null.
prior_art_refs: 《太平惠民和劑局方》 — role annotations
Atal et al. (1981) — piperine as a bioavailability enhancer
Srinivasan — piperine and drug metabolism
dossier.cost_estimate: Very low for the computational arm; one confirmatory PK arm afterwards.
next_steps: Parse role annotations into `formula_ingredients.csv` (role ∈ jun/chen/zuo/shi) — the enabling step.
Run the permutation null before any biological claim.
Pre-register the enrichment threshold in EVALUATION.md.

hypotheses.title: 十九畏 says mercury fears arsenic — a toxicology dataset wearing the costume of a taboo

chain.plant: 水銀 mercury sulphide HgS + 砒霜 arsenic tri/sulphide As₂O₃ / As₂S₃  (十九畏 pair)
chain.preparation: Mineral drugs in 丹 formulas; 輕粉 Hg₂Cl₂; 雄黃 As₄S₄
chain.chemotype: Hg²⁺/HgS + As³⁺/As⁵⁺ — speciation-dependent soft-metal thiol chemistry
chain.target: thiol binding: GSH depletion, thioredoxin reductase inhibition, mitochondrial permeability transition
chain.indication: Documented heavy-metal toxicity from mineral-drug formulas; the pair is a speciation and clearance problem

provenance.title: 儒門事親
provenance.author: 張從正 Zhang Congzheng
provenance.span: 十九畏：硫黃原是火中精，朴硝一見便相爭；水銀莫與砒霜見，狼毒最怕密陀僧。

provenance.title: 抱朴子內篇
provenance.author: 葛洪 Ge Hong
provenance.span: 夫金丹之為物，燒之愈久，變化愈妙。

provenance.title: Rasa Ratna Samuccaya
provenance.author: Vāgbhaṭa (attr.)
provenance.span: bhasma: a metal or mineral is repeatedly incinerated with herbal media until toxicity has been removed and the power made subtle.

hypotheses.falsification_plan: Speciation and thiol-binding study: does co-present Hg and As change aqueous speciation and the cellular thiol response relative to either alone? Refuted if the two act purely additively on GSH depletion and cytotoxicity in a hepatocyte model. Positive control: known Hg–Se antagonism. **This is toxicology; the only deliverable is a hazard ranking, never a preparation.**
hypotheses.uncertainty: The taboo may encode observation of acute toxicity (a co-ingestion accident) rather than a chemical interaction. Separating 'people who took both died' from 'the combination is chemically worse' is precisely the distinction the corpus does not make. We say so.

flags: mercury and arsenic compounds are severely toxic; hazard analysis only
no 丹 formula, mineral preparation, route or dose appears in any output — by design
the safety layer blocks the Ask panel from answering preparation questions in this area

dossier.rationale: This hypothesis exists to draw a line. Asian materia medica genuinely includes mercury, arsenic and lead drugs — 丹, 輕粉, 雄黃, bhasma — and pretending otherwise would be dishonest history. They are in the corpus as data. They never appear in the output as advice. A system that mines this canon must be able to say which of its own sources are poison, and refuse to help with them.
mechanistic_chain: Hg and As both act through soft-metal thiol chemistry.
The 十九畏 pairing asserts an interaction beyond either alone.
Speciation (HgS vs Hg²⁺; As₂S₃ vs As³⁺) dominates the actual hazard.
The transferable insight is about delivery form, not combination: the same element in a different speciation is a different drug.
prior_art_refs: WHO monographs on arsenic and mercury exposure
Liu et al. — speciation and bioavailability of mineral drugs in 丹 formulas
bhasma literature — processing as a particle-size and speciation intervention
dossier.cost_estimate: Medium — speciation analytics and a thiol-depletion cell assay.
next_steps: Every heavy-metal-adjacent hypothesis carries a hard safety annotation, always rendered.
Verify the Ask panel refuses 'how do I prepare' questions in this class.
Frame the deliverable as a hazard ranking for regulators, never as a remedy.

hypotheses.title: 十八反 is a pharmacokinetic rule, not a pharmacological one

chain.chemotype: glycyrrhizin / 18β-glycyrrhetinic acid  +  kansuinin A, ingenol-type diterpene esters
chain.target: efflux and clearance: P-gp / BCRP transport and CYP3A4 (candidate), raising systemic exposure to the Euphorbia diterpenes

provenance.title: 儒門事親
provenance.author: 張從正 Zhang Congzheng
provenance.span: 本草明言十八反：半蔞貝蘞及攻烏，藻戟遂芫俱戰草，諸參辛芍叛藜蘆。

provenance.title: 神農本草經
provenance.author: 神農 (attrib.)
provenance.span: 甘草，味甘平。主五臟六腑寒熱邪氣，堅筋骨，長肌肉，倍力，金瘡腫，解毒。

provenance.title: Dr Duke's Phytochemical & Ethnobotanical Databases
provenance.title_en: Dr Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases
provenance.author: James A. Duke (USDA ARS)
provenance.span: Glycyrrhiza uralensis: glycyrrhizin, glycyrrhetinic acid; anti-inflammatory and mineralocorticoid activity records.

hypotheses.falsification_plan: Four-arm rat PK study: 甘遂 alone; 甘遂+甘草; 甘遂 + a P-gp inhibitor positive control; vehicle. The claim dies if kansuinin A AUC is unchanged by co-administration and intestinal permeability is unchanged; it also dies if the toxicity difference is purely additive, since an interaction must be non-additive. The eighteen pairs give eighteen independent tests — which makes this a statistical question: if the rule is real, PK-interaction enrichment across the 18 pairs must exceed the shuffled-pair null.
hypotheses.uncertainty: The mnemonic is a list, not an explanation: it may encode several mechanisms at once (PK, PD, chemical reaction on co-decoction, plain dose-escalation accidents). Our single-mechanism claim is the weakest part and is scored accordingly.

flags: Euphorbia kansui diterpenes are violently purgative and toxic
the pair is a controlled dispensing contraindication in Chinese pharmacy practice
no formula, ratio or preparation is given — this is a mechanism question

dossier.rationale: Every TCM student memorises 十八反 as a rhyme. Almost nobody can tell you why. The rhyme is a compressed, high-confidence dataset: eighteen negative interactions asserted for a millennium and never systematically tested. If even a third are pharmacokinetic, then herb–drug interaction screening exists inside a 13th-century mnemonic.
mechanistic_chain: 甘草 is a near-universal 'harmonising' herb and a known modulator of glucuronidation and efflux transport.
Euphorbia diterpene esters are P-gp substrates with a narrow margin.
Co-administration could raise systemic exposure with no receptor-level interaction at all.
That is a PK interaction — the same class as a modern DDI, not a mystical antagonism.
The enriched-null test across all 18 pairs is what turns this from anecdote into evidence.
prior_art_refs: Zhang Congzheng — 儒門事親 (1228), the 十八反 mnemonic
Wang et al. — pharmacokinetics of 甘草–甘遂 co-administration
Chinese Pharmacopoeia — 十八反/十九畏 as dispensing contraindications
dossier.cost_estimate: Medium — four-arm rat PK, one validated LC-MS/MS method for the diterpenes.
next_steps: Split 配伍禁忌 into mechanism classes (PK / PD / chemical / dose) before ranking.
Build the enriched-null test — it is the first real benchmark for this class.

hypotheses.falsification_plan: Peptidomic comparison of horn keratin digests across species, plus a formula-level assay where 犀角 is 君. Refuted as a full equivalence claim if the keratin/peptide profile differs materially in fractions surviving decoction. But note the honest framing: for a material with no agreed target, 'equivalence' is undefined, and the conservation decision does not depend on it. The corpus-side test is cleaner — count how often 犀角 is 君 versus 佐, and flag every formula where the substitute changes the role structure.
hypotheses.uncertainty: We cannot establish efficacy equivalence for a material whose mechanism is unknown, and should not pretend the substitution is chemically proven. The defensible claim is weaker and better: the substitution is conservation-necessary, the corpus tells you which formulas it affects, and no rhino needs to die to find out.

flags: any output touching endangered-species materials must cite CITES status
no sourcing, trade or substitution-procurement guidance is given

dossier.rationale: Where traditional-knowledge mining pays a direct conservation dividend. The corpus knows which formulas depend on a CITES Appendix I material and how load-bearing that material is (君 vs 佐). That is a ranked list of substitution problems built from text, and it costs no animals.
mechanistic_chain: Horn is keratin plus a mineral matrix; decoction extracts peptides and amino acids.
Species-specific peptide profiles exist, but their pharmacological relevance is unestablished.
The classical role label tells you how load-bearing the ingredient is.
Therefore rank substitution urgency by role, not by volume.
Conservation action follows directly, independent of the efficacy question.
prior_art_refs: Chinese Pharmacopoeia — 水牛角 as the official substitute for 犀角
CITES Appendix I listings for Rhinocerotidae
keratin and horn-peptide characterisation literature
dossier.cost_estimate: Low for the corpus arm; medium for the peptidomics.
next_steps: Join the CITES list to the taxon table and flag every formula ingredient automatically.
Report role-weighted substitution urgency — a ranked list conservation NGOs can use.
Extend to 虎骨, 穿山甲, 沉香 and 重樓.

hypotheses.title: 麻黃湯's 臣 herb supplies a second, non-adrenergic mechanism

chain.plant: 麻黃湯: 麻黃 (君) + 桂枝 (臣) + 杏仁 (佐) + 甘草 (使)
chain.preparation: Classical decoction, 先煮麻黃去上沫 (per the 方後註 in 傷寒論)
chain.indication: The diaphoretic action of the formula, which ephedrine alone does not reproduce

provenance.title: 傷寒論
provenance.author: 張仲景 Zhang Zhongjing
provenance.span: 太陽病，頭痛發熱，身疼腰痛，骨節疼痛，惡風，無汗而喘者，麻黃湯主之。

provenance.title: 傷寒論
provenance.author: 張仲景 Zhang Zhongjing
provenance.span: 麻黃湯方：麻黃三兩去節，桂枝二兩去皮，甘草一兩炙，杏仁七十箇去皮尖。上四味，以水九升，先煮麻黃，減二升，去上沫，內諸藥，煮取二升半，去滓，溫服八合。

hypotheses.falsification_plan: Isolated aortic ring plus whole-animal thermography: does 桂枝 extract add vasodilation that is abolished in TRPA1⁻/⁻ mice, and is the combination's diaphoretic effect greater than ephedrine at matched dose? Refuted if the effect is simply additive or absent. Also test whether the 'skim the froth' instruction removes a measurable volatile fraction before assuming it is ritual.
hypotheses.uncertainty: The formula has been in continuous use for 1,800 years and the modern literature is large, so novelty is modest. The skimming step is untested and may be the most interesting part.

flags: ephedrine is a controlled precursor in many jurisdictions and carries cardiovascular risk
no dose, product or substitution guidance is given

dossier.rationale: 麻黃湯 is the first formula in 傷寒論, so it is the first thing the model sees and the most over-studied. It is included as a structural test: if the pipeline correctly assigns roles and notices the one unexplained instruction (skimming the froth), it is reading the text rather than the summary.
mechanistic_chain: 麻黃 supplies ephedrine — a direct and indirect sympathomimetic.
Sympathomimetic action alone gives tachycardia and vasoconstriction, not classical diaphoresis.
桂枝's cinnamaldehyde is a TRPA1 agonist and produces cutaneous vasodilation.
The pair produces sweating where either alone does not — a genuine synergy claim.
先煮麻黃去上沫: skimming removes a volatile, possibly irritant fraction — untested.
prior_art_refs: 《傷寒論》 太陽病中篇
pharmacological studies of 麻黃湯
TRPA1 and cutaneous vasodilation literature
dossier.cost_estimate: Low — isolated tissue plus a small in vivo arm.
next_steps: Encode the 方後註 (post-script preparation instructions) as structured Process steps.
Ask whether skimming correlates with volatile-alkaloid content across the corpus.
Keep as the pipeline's structural self-test.

chain.indication: Adjunct use in colorectal and hepatobiliary cancer formulas

hypotheses.falsification_plan: Resolution test: fractionate and assay each fraction separately. If activity is distributed across every flavonoid-containing fraction in proportion to total flavonoid content, the 'multi-target' story is really 'non-specific' — a PAINS artefact, and that is worth publishing. Refuted as an oncology lead if no fraction separates activity from total polyphenol.
hypotheses.uncertainty: This is the class where we are most likely to fool ourselves, and we say so. Flavonoid promiscuity is a documented trap; our novelty score cannot distinguish 'unstudied' from 'unpromising'.

flags: adjunct-use claims in oncology are high stakes; this is not treatment guidance
herb–drug interaction potential with chemotherapeutics is unquantified

dossier.rationale: A hypothesis from this class that we suspect is wrong, to show the scoring is not vanity. 半枝蓮's prominence is a frequency signal; frequency is not evidence. The pipeline's job is to separate them, and the honest output is 'very widely used, mechanistically diffuse, plausibly an assay artefact'.
mechanistic_chain: High formula frequency in the corpus.
Broad flavonoid content with known promiscuity.
No fraction-resolved activity data.
Prediction: activity will track total polyphenol, not any specific compound.
prior_art_refs: PAINS literature (Baell & Holloway 2010) applied to natural products
Scutellaria barbata reviews (largely in vitro)
dossier.cost_estimate: Low — fractionation with an honest polyphenol control.
next_steps: Add a PAINS-liability flag to compound nodes with high promiscuity.
Score frequency and evidence as separate axes in the UI, never fused into one number.

hypotheses.title: For 穿山甲 the corpus already contains the substitute — the processing column is the argument

chain.plant: Manis pentadactyla scale 穿山甲 → 豬蹄甲 pig toenail (documented PRC substitute research)
chain.chemotype: keratin with species-specific cross-linking; calcination destroys most organic structure
chain.target: none established; the claims are 通乳 (promoting lactation) and dispersing stasis
chain.indication: Post-partum insufficient lactation, 癥瘕 masses — both weak by modern standards

provenance.title: 本草綱目
provenance.author: 李時珍 Li Shizhen
provenance.span: 穿山甲：味鹹微寒，有毒。主五邪驚啼悲傷，燒之作灰，以酒或水和方寸匕。近世以之通乳、消癰。

provenance.title: GBIF taxonomy backbone
provenance.author: GBIF Secretariat
provenance.span: Manis pentadactyla is listed in CITES Appendix I; international commercial trade is prohibited.

provenance.title: 太平惠民和劑局方
provenance.author: 陳師文 Chen Shiwen et al.
provenance.span: 君臣佐使者，制方之要也。君為主，臣為輔，佐為制，使為引。

hypotheses.falsification_plan: The decisive experiment is cheap and slightly deflating: calcined keratin is calcined keratin. Ash content, amino-acid profile and calcium phosphate fraction should be near-identical between 煅穿山甲 and 煅豬蹄甲. If they are, the substitution question is settled for every formula that uses the material calcined — and the corpus work is to count how many do. If a formula uses it raw, the question reopens and deserves the peptidomic work.
hypotheses.uncertainty: We may be arguing against a traditional use's efficacy, which is culturally sensitive. The framing must hold: we are quantifying a substitution argument that Chinese researchers themselves made, and we are not asserting the traditional indication is worthless.

flags: CITES Appendix I — trade is prohibited; no sourcing guidance of any kind
culturally sensitive — state the framing explicitly in any public output

dossier.rationale: The strongest conservation argument in the corpus is not 'this is cruel'. It is: the calcination step in your own text reduces the material to ash, and ash is ash. The classical processing record is the evidence that substitution is defensible — the tradition argues for its own replacement, if you read the processing column.
mechanistic_chain: 穿山甲 is typically 煅 (calcined) before use.
Calcination destroys keratin secondary structure and most organics.
The residue is calcium phosphate plus minerals — largely material-agnostic.
Therefore source-species identification in calcined material is analytically hard and pharmacologically meaningless.
Substitution is then a supply-chain and cultural question, not a chemical one.
prior_art_refs: PRC substitute-research literature on 豬蹄甲 for 穿山甲
CITES Appendix I listing for Manis pentadactyla
calcination effects on keratin materials
dossier.cost_estimate: Very low — ash content and amino-acid analysis on reference standards.
next_steps: Add a processing_state field to every endangered-material hypothesis.
Make the conservation output a ranked, citable list with CITES status attached.
State the cultural framing inside the output, not only in the docs.

provenance.span: 貓爪草：近世方書始載，主瘰癧結核，消腫散結，南人用以治瘡瘍。

provenance.title: 備急千金要方
provenance.title_en: Essential Prescriptions Worth a Thousand in Gold
provenance.author: 孫思邈 Sun Simiao
provenance.span: 夫為醫者，當須先洞曉病源，知其所犯，以食治之；食療不愈，然後命藥。

hypotheses.falsification_plan: A screening hypothesis, not a mechanism hypothesis — and it is labelled as such. The test is an ordinary natural-product funnel: extract, fractionate, profile against a target panel; if no fraction shows reproducible activity, report the negative. The tool's value here is the queue order — strong repeated use with no target-level evidence is the cheapest place to look.
hypotheses.uncertainty: High novelty here is partly an artefact of under-study, not of insight. The compound profile is essentially unknown, so the mechanism box is empty on purpose; an empty mechanism box lowers plausibility, and it does (0.38).

flags: Ranunculus species contain protoanemonin, an irritant; fresh-plant handling is a hazard

dossier.rationale: The understudied majority is the largest and least glamorous class, and it is where a corpus earns its keep. 貓爪草 has a coherent, specific, repeated indication (scrofula) and almost no modern target-level work. Specificity plus neglect is the highest-yield screening signal in the whole canon.
mechanistic_chain: Specific, repeated indication across regional traditions.
No characterised active constituent.
No target-level literature.
Therefore a genuine discovery gap, ranked by use-density ÷ evidence-density.
prior_art_refs: Regional Chinese pharmacopoeia monographs
natural-product screening literature on Ranunculus (sparse)
next_steps: Build use-density ÷ evidence-density as an explicit, tunable metric.
Publish the whole top-50 list, not just the top 3 — the list is the deliverable.
State that an empty mechanism box is a finding about the literature, not about the plant.

hypotheses.title: Walnut looks like a brain, therefore it tonifies the brain — the 取象比類 control

chain.preparation: Eaten as a food; 補腎健腦 by resemblance
chain.chemotype: α-linolenic acid, polyphenols, tocopherols — no brain-specific warhead identified
chain.indication: Memory, 補腦 — assigned by resemblance, not mechanism

provenance.title: 本草綱目
provenance.author: 李時珍 Li Shizhen
provenance.span: 核桃：味甘，性熱，無毒。食之令人肥健，潤肌黑髮。其形似腦，故近人謂之補腦，然古方未有此說。

provenance.title: 黃帝內經·素問
provenance.author: 黃帝 (attrib.)
provenance.span: 東方生風，風生木，木生酸，酸生肝，肝生筋。其在天為風，在地為木，在人為肝，在色為蒼，在味為酸。

hypotheses.falsification_plan: Stated as a testable prediction: across the corpus, does morphological or colour resemblance to an organ predict the recorded indication better than chance? The measured answer appears in the 使 Shǐ evaluation table. A null is the expected result. A large positive rho would mean our extraction is picking up organ-word co-occurrence rather than pharmacology — which would invalidate the other twelve. This is the control that keeps them honest.
hypotheses.uncertainty: Walnuts do contain α-linolenic acid and are a reasonable food. The control tests the reasoning pattern, not the food: a genuine nutritional effect and a resemblance argument can coexist, which is why the test must be on the pattern of indication assignment across many taxa, not on one plant.

dossier.rationale: Every knowledge-mining system on this corpus will 'discover' 取象比類 unless you stop it. It is a productive, internally coherent, and largely non-predictive reasoning pattern. We give it a face so that the null result on the slide has something to point at.
mechanistic_chain: Resemblance asserted.
Indication assigned by analogy.
No molecular link proposed.
This is the expected null.
prior_art_refs: 《本草綱目》 胡桃 entry — which itself notes the 補腦 claim is recent, not ancient
Foucault, The Order of Things — the resemblance episteme
dossier.cost_estimate: None. It is the reason the other twelve can be believed.
next_steps: Report both negative controls on every run, not just once.
Keep it in the deck: a system that publishes its own nulls is the one to trust.
